evidence.name: Screen field: Checkbox placement in grid cells
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Checkbox placement in grid cells" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Checkbox placement in grid cells
sections.description: On grid cells, show or hide the selection checkbox and place it in a corner (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, or bottom-right) with an optional offset. Keep it visible on multi-select grids so visitors can see what they've picked; top-right is a common, unobtrusive spot. Only appears on grid layouts.
